name: nostalgia

stages.name: 古い写真
stages.description: 一枚の写真から記憶が開く
stages.prompt: nostalgic anime illustration, old photograph album on a wooden desk, afternoon sunlight and floating dust motes

stages.name: 放課後
stages.description: 誰もいない教室に夏の風が吹く
stages.prompt: cinematic anime illustration, empty school classroom in late summer, curtains moving in breeze, warm nostalgic light

stages.name: 帰り道
stages.description: 見慣れた道をゆっくり歩く
stages.prompt: anime cinematic landscape, quiet rural road bordered by grasses, golden hour, wistful summer atmosphere

stages.name: 祭りの記憶
stages.description: 遠くに祭囃子と提灯が揺れる
stages.prompt: beautiful anime illustration, nostalgic Japanese summer festival, glowing lanterns, distant fireworks, atmospheric crowd

stages.name: 新しいページ
stages.description: 思い出を胸に未来へ進む
stages.prompt: anime cinematic illustration, character walking toward a bright morning along a familiar country road, bittersweet hope

character.description: the same recurring anime protagonist in the nostalgia world, with consistent face, hairstyle, outfit silhouette, age impression, and body proportions throughout the entire music video
consistency_rules: keep the same face and hairstyle across scenes
keep outfit design and color identity consistent unless the story explicitly changes them
keep age impression, body proportions, and character identity stable
do not introduce additional protagonists unless the lyrics or scene require them

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in old family home, empty school corridor, rural train station; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with faded gold, dusty blue, cream, warm brown; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by soft focus close-up, slow pan across old objects, wide nostalgic landscape; clear subject separation and intentional negative space

camera_guidance.principle: vary shot scale and viewpoint to support the scene; avoid repeating identical framing in consecutive scenes
